info.name: AeroTrace - Identity (via api-gateway)
info.description: The authentication API of the identity-service, called through the api-gateway (default http://localhost:8080). Folders follow the API: 1 Register (passenger, staff, refusals), 2 Login, 3 Refresh token, 4 Forgot password, 5 Reset password, 6 Logout, 7 Gateway rules, 8 the identity-service on its own port. Run the whole collection top to bottom with the runner: folder 1 creates the passenger that the later folders use, and the token variables are stored in the environment by the test scripts. The gateway limits each address to about 10 requests per second (burst 20), so run with a delay of 150 ms or more between requests. Folder 1.2 signs in as adminUsername / adminPassword, which the environment sets to the dev dummy admin (dummy.admin, password dummy-password-1; created by the dev Liquibase context of the compose stack). Without that context change them, or make the first admin by hand (see the README). Every login stores its tokens in the environment (accessToken / refreshToken for the passenger, agent..., dispatcher..., newAdmin..., admin... for the others), so any request can also be run on its own.
